## 2. Methods
:::

Headings with the `.sec-line` class get a coloured rule above them, a lighter alternative to the full band. This column spans **7 of 12** grid columns. Inline math is supported out of the box: $y = f(\mathbf{x}) + \varepsilon$, with $\varepsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \sigma^2)$.

### 2.2 Subsection title {.sub}

Level-3 headings with the `.sub` class are rendered as uppercase subsection titles. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Vivamus sagittis lacus vel augue laoreet rutrum faucibus dolor auctor. Donec ullamcorper nulla non metus auctor fringilla. Maecenas faucibus mollis interdum. Cras mattis consectetur purus sit amet fermentum. Aenean lacinia bibendum nulla sed consectetur. Display equations work as well:

$$
\hat{\theta} = \arg\min_{\theta} \; \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N} \mathcal{L}\left(y_i, f_\theta(\mathbf{x}_i)\right) + \lambda \|\theta\|_2^2
$$
